method.hover: a real mouse moves onto the text, then away to the page corner; the first and the second hover are on one page load
method.keyboard: a fresh page load; the harness sets tabindex="0" on the cell's own Text element (stock cells have no Tab stop), then presses Tab until that element has focus; Escape ends it
method.count: the elements with role="tooltip" in the document, and those of them with a non-empty box, visibility visible, display not none and opacity above 0, at 100, 300, 600, 1000, 1500 and 2500 ms
method.fullText: a tooltip's textContent equals the Text element's textContent
method.rest: the viewport and the story area with 8 CSS px around it, after three identical screenshots in a row
method.stills: at 1000 ms, the text and every visible tooltip with 16 CSS px around them
